targets.adjudication_verdict: GENUINE PASS, scoped to the ACCUMULATION side of the substrate. The zero in the escapable arm is analytic (g_t=0 -> drive 0), but the probe's informative content is that the construction is actually wired into the live sense() path: over 180 live ticks the escapable arm accumulated exactly 0.0 suffering while carrying z_harm_un 0.54-0.70 (C3 non-vacuity), the external escapability lever demonstrably reaches the accumulator, and SD-021 attenuation fired 5/5 without touching the escapability scalar (C4 parity). A mis-wiring on the accumulation path (escapability not plumbed; drive using u_t alone; SD-021 leaking into the gate) would have failed these criteria. C2's half-life 69.0 is the EXACT discrete-EMA prediction (ceil(ln 0.5 / ln 0.99)) and the release arithmetic is seed-independent, so C2 verifies the-code-is-the-documented-code rather than anything behavioural -- real but deliberately weak. SCOPE LIMIT (red-team finding, recorded): the probe reads s_t from accumulator.get_state(), never from the latent, and every harm_suffering_redirect_* consumer flag is OFF in this config -- so the accumulator's OUTPUT path and all downstream consumers are UNVERIFIED by this run (the agent.py vector-build line could be deleted and all four criteria would still pass). 'Substrate readiness confirmed' therefore means accumulation-side readiness; the behavioural run must independently establish the output/consumer side. Degeneracy scan clean; the deliberately-constant escapable-suffering series is correctly excluded with its non-vacuity carried by C3. Self-route label accurate at its stated scope.

learning_extracted: The readiness-first, claim_ids=[] discipline (memo Sec 7, V3-EXQ-518 precedent) worked exactly as designed: first-ever run against a new substrate produced an adjudicable wiring verdict without contaminating MECH-219's evidence record.

An analytically-forced zero (g_t=0 -> drive 0) can still carry real information when the criterion set includes non-vacuity of the input (C3 un_floor) and live-path plumbing checks -- the vacuous-pass risk was pre-empted in the design rather than found at autopsy.

Rejected-design record in the driver (physical-relocation relief REJECTED because untrained-encoder z_harm_un rises after relocation, 0.55->1.45 over 200 ticks) is a caveat the follow-on behavioural run must inherit: on an untrained or lightly-trained encoder, relocation-based relief operationalisations are confounded.
targets.routing_note: Follow-on is the behavioural MECH-219/SD-019b evidence run the scope_note names: claim_ids=['MECH-219'], trained substrate, C3(b) anti-correlation with MECH-353 z_block_assert, full z_harm_s attenuation-magnitude C4, escapability from avoidance_efficacy once SD-058 clears (external mode remains valid fallback). Per the red-team pass, that run MUST additionally: (1) enable the harm_suffering_redirect_* consumer flags -- MECH-219's own what_would_answer requires redirect-flag enablement, and 957 leaves the entire output/consumer path unverified (dead-end register in this config); (2) test the memo-Sec-7 C2 CONTRAST half that 957 did not (z_harm_un releases FAST after offset while s_t releases slowly -- the temporal dissociation between input and accumulator, not just the accumulator's own decay constant). New EXQ number (different question: behavioural temporal signature vs wiring readiness). NOT spawned by this session -- /governance chips it after ratifying this disposition (2026-07-30 rule).
